summary: Lincoln County, MT lookout site in the Kootenai NF near Yaak; L-4 cab dated 1933, destroyed 1953 per firelookout.com; FFLA Montana list marks it gone.

facts.design: L-4 cab; listed as a ground-level structure by the FFLA
facts.status_note: firelookout.com says the L-4 cab was destroyed in 1953; the FFLA Montana list also marks the site gone
facts.agency: Kootenai National Forest (as named on firelookout.com)

evidence.supports: site lies inside the Kootenai National Forest
lookout is about 11 miles south of Yaak
coordinates 48.67514, -115.66608; listed as Ground type, Gone status
association's Montana list marks the site gone
